swimming_pool.evidence: Kidney-shaped turquoise water surface with surrounding stone patio and lounge chairs just west of the central house.

detached_structure.evidence: A small gray-roofed rectangular building (possible shed or pool house) sits northwest of the pool at the edge of the lawn, though it may belong to the central lot or a neighbor.

signals.notes: Central house has a rear in-ground pool with patio, a circular paved driveway, and a gray roof in uniform condition; mature trees border the west side of the lot, and two dark vehicles are parked in the driveway near the road.
